items.name: intelligo
items.title: Intelligo design system
items.description: The base every Intelligo page is built on: shadcn base-nova on Base UI, the neutral theme with its focus ring, muted text and destructive raised to WCAG AA, and additive tokens for status (success, warning, info, destructive-foreground), layers and motion. Initialise an app from it before installing any other item.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action primitive: presses in and settles back — six variants, eight sizes, composes through render.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox whose check draws itself in, with an indeterminate state.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: One choice from a set; the dot springs out from the centre.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off control with a weighted thumb that squeezes while pressed.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single-line text field whose border and soft ring ease in on focus.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short hint on hover or focus that grows out of its trigger; neighbours open instantly.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating content in a rounded panel that scales out of its trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Actions, checkboxes and radio groups with submenus, in a panel that scales out of its trigger.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A picker for one value from a list, on the input's field and the menu's panel.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window over a blurred backdrop that springs up into place.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: Alert Dialog
items.description: A modal that confirms a destructive or irreversible action, with the dialog's backdrop and spring.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel that slides in from any edge on the drawer curve.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views with one indicator that glides from tab to tab — raised and line variants.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Content that eases open and closed from its measured height.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A rounded bar whose fill glides to each new value.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Pending state: a faint ring with a running arc. Pair with disabled and aria-busy.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file attached to a message or a prompt.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input Group
items.description: An input or textarea with inline addons, buttons and text.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A searchable list of actions, inline or in a dialog.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app sidebar — collapsible to icons, keyboard-toggled, a sheet on mobile.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The one page title every Intelligo page renders: heading, description and actions.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: Stat Card
items.description: A metric on a card — label, value, an action such as a status badge, and a footer.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: Status Badge
items.description: A status shown in a status token — neutral, info, success, warning or destructive — never a palette colour.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy to the clipboard with confirmation and a live announcement; labels are passed in, so it carries no copy of its own.

items.name: ai-code-block
items.title: AI Code Block
items.description: Highlighted code that streams without layout shift: header with filename, language, status and copy action, line numbers, focused lines, light and dark.

items.name: ai-markdown
items.title: AI Markdown
items.description: Markdown as a model writes it — GFM, highlighted code, CJK emphasis — with maths and diagrams fetched only when the text contains them.

items.name: ai-reasoning
items.title: AI Reasoning
items.description: Streamed reasoning, collapsible, with the time it took.

items.name: ai-suggestion
items.title: AI Suggestion
items.description: Conversation starters and follow-ups in a scrollable row.

items.name: ai-artifact
items.title: AI Artifact
items.description: A generated document's frame: header, actions and content.

items.name: ai-prompt-input
items.title: AI Prompt Input
items.description: The chat composer: autosizing textarea that sends on Enter, attachments by picker, drop and paste, an action menu, selects, and a submit that stops a streaming reply.

items.name: ai-branch
items.title: AI Branch
items.description: A pager over the versions of a reply or an edited message — previous, next, `2 / 3`.

items.name: ai-speech-input
items.title: AI Speech Input
items.description: Voice into the composer on the browser's speech recognition; renders nothing where it is absent.

items.name: ai-composer-menu
items.title: AI Composer Menu
items.description: The picker a composer opens for slash commands and @ mentions, anchored above the textarea.

items.name: ai-motion
items.title: AI Motion
items.description: The motion vocabulary every tier shares: easing curves, spring presets, a transform-only disclosure, a text swap, the popup and backdrop presets the primitives open with, the button press and list staggers, all gated on reduced motion.

items.name: ai-shimmer-text
items.title: AI Shimmer Text
items.description: A status line that reads as alive while the agent works; a token gradient sweeps the text and the words swap with motion, honouring reduced motion.

items.name: ai-agent-activity
items.title: AI Agent Activity
items.description: One adaptive stream of what the agent is doing: reasoning text, plan steps, web searches with results, tool calls and structured traces, gliding while it works and folding into a summary when done.

items.name: ai-approval-card
items.title: AI Approval Card
items.description: A decision surface: approve, reject or request changes, or step through single-choice, multiple-choice and freeform questions and submit the answers.

items.name: ai-file-diff
items.title: AI File Diff
items.description: A file the agent is changing: the path with live added and removed counts, opening onto a unified diff whose highlighted rows arrive while the change streams.

items.name: ai-message-bubble
items.title: AI Message Bubble
items.description: The speech bubble inside a message row: six surface variants that pop into place, grouped bubbles and a collapsible long body.

items.name: ai-message-scroller
items.title: AI Message Scroller
items.description: The scrolling transcript: follows streamed output while the reader stays at the live edge, lets go when they scroll up, with an optional preview rail for jumping between messages.

items.name: ai-message
items.title: AI Message
items.description: One turn of a conversation: the row with its side, optional avatar, content column, header, footer, a centred marker and the typing indicator.

items.name: ai-todo-list
items.title: AI Todo List
items.description: The agent's to-do list: a collapsible plan whose status marks morph between pending, in progress, completed and cancelled, with a rolling completion count.

items.name: ai-tool-approval
items.title: AI Tool Approval
items.description: A permission card for a tool call: name, parameters behind a disclosure, allow once / always allow / deny, and the outcome as a status.

items.name: ai-tool-result
items.title: AI Tool Result
items.description: The result of a tool the agent ran: a summary line that opens onto highlighted output, status rolling from running to done, copy and run-again actions.

items.name: ai-agent-progress
items.title: AI Agent Progress
items.description: A long-running step: a pulsing grid beside the verb and an elapsed-time counter.

items.name: ai-citations
items.title: AI Citations
items.description: The sources an answer leans on: inline source pills with a hover preview, favicon stacks, a sources sheet and a collapsible reference list.

items.name: ai-image-generation
items.title: AI Image Generation
items.description: An image the agent is making: reserved frame, dither field while queued and generating, media sharpening in as it refines and completes.

items.name: ai-reasoning-text
items.title: AI Reasoning Text
items.description: What the agent is doing while it reasons: phrases cycle with a cascade, swap or scramble behind an ASCII loader.

items.name: ai-streaming-response
items.title: AI Streaming Response
items.description: An assistant reply as it streams and once it lands: content, copy, retry and feedback actions, and a sources disclosure.

items.name: ai-sidebar
items.title: AI Sidebar
items.description: The AI product's sidebar: a shell that morphs between a panel and an icon rail with tooltips, slides in as a sheet on mobile, holds menus with a gliding hover and active pill and staggered submenus, and a resource tree of folders, projects, conversations, files and bookmarks with keyboard and drag-and-drop moves, rename and a row menu.

items.name: document-viewer
items.title: Document Viewer
items.description: How a saved document reads when nobody is editing it: markdown with maths and diagrams, highlighted code, a sheet's rows, an image, and a sandboxed HTML preview — plus the title-to-language and kind-glyph helpers the chat canvas and the artifacts library share.

items.name: popover-morph
items.title: Popover Morph
items.description: A non-modal popover whose trigger surface grows into the panel through a shared layout and folds back on close.

items.name: select-morph
items.title: Select Morph
items.description: A select whose trigger continues into its list: the list unclips down from the trigger's edge as one surface while its options stagger in.

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Morphing Modal
items.description: A card or button that grows into a centred or bottom dialog through a shared layout, cross-fading between views while the panel resizes.

items.name: notification-stack
items.title: Notification Stack
items.description: Notifications fanned into a stack — the newest in front, the rest peeking out scaled back — that springs apart into a list of openable, dismissable cards on hover or click.

items.name: animated-list
items.title: Animated List
items.description: A list container that staggers its rows in on mount, rows that rise in, fall out and glide on reorder (ul, ol, div or tbody/tr), and a block that reveals once as it scrolls into view.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code input on Base UI's OTP Field whose characters roll into their slots under a blinking caret, shaking on a rejected code and drawing a check on an accepted one.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A controlled file upload — a drop zone with a queue of rows that slide in, fill a progress bar and settle on done or error, or a compact chat-composer wrapper with a drop overlay and chips.

items.name: expandable-tabs
items.title: Expandable Tabs
items.description: A bar of icon tabs on Base UI's Tabs where the active tab widens to unfurl its label, the pill glides to it and its panel rises in.

items.name: hold-action-button
items.title: Hold Action Button
items.description: A press-and-hold confirmation for a destructive action, by pointer or held Space/Enter, whose fill sweeps across while held and drains on an early release.

items.name: smoke
items.title: Registry Smoke Test
items.description: Permanent canary item that proves the registry build and install pipeline end to end.

items.name: route-error
items.title: Route Error States
items.description: The app's error surfaces: a shared RouteError component every error.tsx renders, message-based error classification, an (app) group boundary, a translated 404, and a dependency-free global-error. Error reporting goes through the lib/error-reporting.ts seam (a no-op until you bind a reporter), so no SDK enters the registry. Items that ship an error.tsx depend on this one - install it first.

items.name: team-settings
items.title: Team Settings
items.description: Workspace team management: invite members, change roles, remove members, and manage pending invitations, backed by the framework's team service.

items.name: usage
items.title: Usage
items.description: Workspace usage dashboard: current-period summary tiles, a period selector, and a table of recent AI execution records.

items.name: invitation-accept
items.title: Invitation Accept
items.description: Accept or decline a workspace invitation via the team service. Requires the team-settings item (provides lib/team.ts and the role badge); install it first.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: Authenticated application shell: session and onboarding gate, workspace bootstrap, a sidebar that morphs into an icon rail with a gliding active pill, workspace switcher, configurable nav and user menu, and a page region that lifts each section in.

items.name: settings-shell
items.title: Settings Shell
items.description: The shared frame around every /settings page: layout with heading and width constraint, a configurable tab bar (lib/settings-nav.ts), and a /settings index that redirects to the first tab. Install alongside the settings items - without it they render unframed and plain /settings links 404.

items.name: workspace-settings
items.title: Workspace Settings
items.description: Workspace name/URL editing and owner-only deletion, backed by the framework's workspace service.

items.name: auth-login
items.title: Auth: Login
items.description: Email/password and OAuth login. Ships the shared auth route layout, the de-branded AuthCard shell, and the auth-validation.ts zod schemas reused by auth-signup, auth-password-reset, and auth-email-verification - install this item first.

items.name: auth-signup
items.title: Auth: Signup
items.description: Email/password and OAuth account creation. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell, SocialLoginButtons, and lib/auth-validation.ts schemas); install it first. Redirects to auth-email-verification's /verify-email route when the server requires email verification.

items.name: auth-password-reset
items.title: Auth: Password Reset
items.description: Forgot-password and reset-password pages, backed by the Better-Auth client SDK's requestPasswordReset/resetPassword actions. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell and lib/auth-validation.ts schemas); install it first.

items.name: auth-email-verification
items.title: Auth: Email Verification
items.description: Post-signup email verification status page with a resend control, backed by the Better-Auth client SDK's sendVerificationEmail action. Reads the ?error=/?email= search params Better-Auth's own /verify-email link handler redirects back with. Requires the auth-login item (provides the shared AuthCard shell); install it first.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language Switcher
items.description: Locale dropdown over the locales i18n/routing.ts declares, labeled with each language's own name. Renders nothing in a single-locale deployment, so it is safe to mount unconditionally (e.g. in shellConfig.headerRight). Adding a locale to routing.ts plus a messages directory is the whole job.

items.name: trial-banner
items.title: Trial Banner
items.description: Dismissable trial-status strip for the app shell's bannerTop seam: days and credits remaining with an upgrade CTA, urgency-ramped visuals, dismiss-for-today, and a consumer config (lib/trial-banner-config.ts) for the CTA target and route suppression (hidden on /chat by default). Bind TrialBannerContainer as shellConfig.bannerTop.

items.name: notifications
items.title: Notifications
items.description: Notification bell with an unread badge and dropdown, plus a full notifications page with mark-as-read and load-more, backed by the framework's notification records.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Plan comparison and upgrade page with a monthly/yearly toggle, backed by the framework's checkout service and the product's registered plan catalogue. Ships the lib/billing.ts product binding and actions/billing.ts checkout actions that the checkout and billing-settings items also depend on — install this item first.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: Checkout-success page that verifies the Stripe session directly through the framework's checkout service, covering the webhook-race window between the browser redirect and Stripe's webhook delivery.

items.name: billing-settings
items.title: Billing Settings
items.description: Workspace billing management: current plan, credit balance, credit bundle purchase, and the Stripe billing portal, shaped server-side by role (member/admin/owner). Requires the pricing item (provides lib/billing.ts and actions/billing.ts); install it first.

items.name: feature-gating
items.title: Feature Gating
items.description: The vocabulary for selling a plan: a server-side FeatureGate that renders gated content only to entitled workspaces, three densities of upgrade prompt (full, compact, inline), a quota warning that escalates as a limit approaches, and a preview paywall that blurs content instead of hiding it. Which features exist and which plan unlocks them is consumer config (lib/feature-catalog.ts). Install pricing or billing-settings for somewhere to send the user.

items.name: payment-poll
items.title: QR Payment (poll)
items.description: The non-card checkout the catalogue was missing: issue an invoice, show a QR the user scans in their banking app, poll until the provider confirms. Provider-agnostic — QPay, SocialPay, PIX, UPI, PromptPay all fit — with the invoice recorded and a paid one granted on the server; lib/local-payment.ts says what each reference costs and grants. Requires the pricing item for lib/billing-config.ts's CURRENCY.

items.name: profile-settings
items.title: Profile Settings
items.description: User profile name editing, read-only email, and account deletion with typed confirmation, backed by the framework's profile service.

items.name: onboarding
items.title: Onboarding
items.description: A generic multi-step onboarding wizard driven by a consumer-owned steps config: text and single-select-card fields, a completion screen, skip, and back/next - backed by the framework's onboarding service (durable step progress, no vertical-specific UI).

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: An AI-first workspace home: a hero and a real composer centred as one unit, starter chips that fill it, and a resume affordance for unfinished work — and nothing else, because history belongs to the sidebar and spend to /usage. Configurable through lib/dashboard-config.tsx (copy, starters, chat base path) and lib/dashboard-data.ts (what "resume" means). Pairs with the chat item for its /chat routes; install it first.

items.name: artifacts
items.title: Artifacts
items.description: Browse and manage AI-generated document artifacts: filterable list, full-content preview, copy-to-clipboard, and version delete, backed by the framework's document persistence service.

items.name: privacy-settings
items.title: Privacy Settings
items.description: GDPR-style data export, a read-only memory-audit trail, and per-category fact listing with delete, backed by the framework's identity service.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: A ChatGPT-level AI chat surface: a streaming thread with edit, regenerate and response versions, attachments, a model picker, reasoning, sources, tool cards and human-in-the-loop approvals, agent activity for Mastra and eve turns, a canvas beside the chat for documents a tool streams, a sidebar with pinned and dated groups, share links and feedback — on a two-line Route Handler that binds @intelligo-dev/chat's transport (auth, rate limit, feature gate, persistence, the execution boundary) to consumer-owned config (lib/chat-server-config.ts). Every tool renders through one entry in lib/chat-renderers.tsx, inline and in the canvas. Ships with a deterministic stub model so a clean install streams with no API keys. The config imports lib/intelligo.ts (the composition root) and lib/plans.ts, which are provided by the `intelligo create` scaffold, not by any registry item - in a hand-rolled app, create both before installing (see the CLI's app-scaffold templates).

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat Panel
items.description: The chat as a side panel on any page: a sheet that opens the same thread the chat page runs, with the page's context on every turn. Requires the chat item.

items.name: chat-widget
items.title: Chat Widget
items.description: The floating assistant: a launcher in a corner of every page and a compact chat over it, configured in lib/chat-widget-config.tsx. Requires the chat item.

items.name: chat-share
items.title: Chat Share
items.description: A conversation its owner published, readable by anyone with the link at /share/[id]: the same transcript, read-only, minus reasoning, tool details and attachments. Requires the chat item.

items.name: chat-eve
items.title: Chat: eve binding
items.description: eve through the chat transport: a streamTurn for lib/chat-server-config.ts that runs a turn as an eve session over HTTP and NDJSON and maps its events to the AI SDK's chunks — text, reasoning, tool calls, approvals, questions, subagents, authorization — so an eve agent renders through the same tool renderers as any other. Consumer-owned; imports nothing from eve. Requires the chat item.
